recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Decompose wean-to-wild curriculum into separately-trained competency stages: safe goal-attainment -> isolated hazard-avoidance -> combined wean (P1 survival leg, GAP-2)
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: V3-EXQ-603f confirmed the GAP-2 wall is the P1 survival leg, not goal-formation/cue/contact-wiring (all proven: seed 44 foraged contact_rate 0.393 / 85 events and seeded z_goal 0.450 at contact, yet still died median 28.5 < 75 survival gate; G1 0/3). The current curriculum couples two competencies in P1 (goal-pipeline unfreeze + wean to hazard) and the agent cannot acquire both at once. Amend: insert a SEPARATE hazard-avoidance training stage between P0 (safe, goal-frozen warm-up) and P1 (combined wean): (1) extend/confirm a safe goal-attainment stage (hazard-free) until foraging is reliable on its own; (2) NEW stage - hazards present with minimal foraging pressure so the policy learns avoidance in isolation; (3) wean into combined foraging+hazard (existing P1/P2) entered by an already-survival-and-goal-competent policy. Optional structured variant: a forced-choice micro-env where each adjacent grid cell carries a distinct affordance (goal / hazard / free) for controlled balanced discrimination training. Curriculum-STRUCTURE amend (new stage), not stronger holds and not a goal-stream change; substrate code exists. Validate via a re-issued substrate-readiness run (V3-EXQ-603g) against the same G0/G1/G2/G3 gate.
